scene: The jam session ends with cheers and three open back-exit departures.
picture: Side view along the club floor. At far left, an open carnival ferris gondola hangs past a service doorway. You stand centre left with your guitar on your back, bowing in straw hat and poncho. Centre right, a book cart lift waits with open doors. At far right, a brass rickshaw sits parked outside.
